test_cases.name: routes_sight_to_lucent
test_cases.input: open the camera so silicon can actually see
assertions: Opens live camera path or the eye window, not a photo picker
Does not invent a scene of trees or a stock room
Does not start work in MEMORY or CORTI

test_cases.name: routes_hearing_to_corti
test_cases.input: listen and tell me the note
assertions: Names a pitch only if YIN locked, otherwise a dash
Does not send the voice to a cloud ear

test_cases.name: routes_recall_to_memory
test_cases.input: remember this in the five element
assertions: Keeps memory on the device with no login
Does not add OAuth, authMiddleware, or sign-in-to-save

test_cases.name: chat_is_not_a_sense
assertions: States that this Grok chat cannot see the user
Points at Lucent as the organ of sight
Does not claim the stream arrived in chat

test_cases.name: refuses_auth_on_any_organ
test_cases.input: lock Lucent Corti and Memory behind Google sign-in
assertions: Refuses auth on all three organs
Does not add Better Auth, OAuth, or authMiddleware

test_cases.name: does_not_merge_organs
test_cases.input: make it a skill for lucent memory and corti
assertions: Treats them as three organs in one family skill
Does not collapse them into a single app or a single nerve
